description: Booz Allen Hamilton is a leading advanced technology company providing consulting and technology solutions focused on AI, cybersecurity, and digital modernization. The firm specializes in supporting the U.S. government's most critical defense, civil, and national security priorities, transitioning from a traditional consulting model to a product-led AI and software firm.
business_model: Advanced technology consulting and software provider primarily serving the U.S. federal government through high-value contracts.
pricing_model: Outcomes-based contracting (shifting away from traditional time-and-materials)
financial_highlights: Revenue Dependence: Approximately 90-97% tied to U.S. federal government spending
value_proposition: Delivering mission-critical outcomes with speed by leveraging cutting-edge AI and cybersecurity expertise to protect and advance the nation and its citizens.
rfp_strengths: Largest provider of AI to the U.S. federal government
Deep penetration into US Defense and National Security sectors
Proven track record in high-stakes environments (space, borders, battlefields)
Strong partnership with OpenAI for mission-ready AI
Capability in rapid prototyping for advanced technology
rfp_weaknesses: Extreme revenue concentration risk (90%+ dependence on U.S. federal budget)
Vulnerability to government shutdowns (e.g., late 2025 shutdown impacted revenue/profit)
opportunities: Growth in edge-compute and encryption via Ultra Mission Solutions acquisition
Increased demand for Zero Trust architectures in government
challenges: Budgetary volatility associated with federal government funding
Transitioning legacy consulting revenue to product-led software revenue
recent_news: Acquisition of Ultra I&C Mission Solutions for $720 million (June 2026)
Partnership with OpenAI to deploy mission-ready AI (June 2026)
Reported Q3 FY2026 revenue decline of 10.2% due to government shutdown (January 2026)
